declarations.name: doubleCompletion
declarations.headOrValue:
def doubleCompletion (nu : Measure BridgeNoise) (x w : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  nu.real ((strictUpper x 0 1 w)ᶜ ∩ (strictLower x 0 1 w)ᶜ)

declarations.name: doubleCompletion_eq
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem doubleCompletion_eq (nu : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x w : ℝ) :
    doubleCompletion nu x w =
      1 - upperCompletion nu x 0 1 w - lowerCompletion nu x 0 1 w +
        intervalCompletion nu x 0 1 w

declarations.name: doubleCompletion_bounds
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem doubleCompletion_bounds (nu : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x w : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ doubleCompletion nu x w ∧ doubleCompletion nu x w ≤ 1

declarations.name: measurable_doubleCompletion
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem measurable_doubleCompletion (nu : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x : ℝ) : Measurable (doubleCompletion nu x)

declarations.name: doubleCompletion_exterior
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem doubleCompletion_exterior
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x)
    (w : ℝ) (hw : x ≤ |w|) :
    doubleCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) x w = Real.exp (-2 * x * (x + |w|))

declarations.name: doubleCompletion_interior_images
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem doubleCompletion_interior_images
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x)
    (w : ℝ) (hw : |w| < x) :
    doubleCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) x w =
      Real.exp (-Shao.C2.IntervalImageExponents.imageA x 0 w 1) +
        Real.exp (-Shao.C2.IntervalImageExponents.imageA x 0 w (-1)) +
          ∑' n : ℕ, Shao.C2.IntervalImageSpatialConvergence.spatialTailBlock 0 x w 1 0 n

declarations.name: initial_image_tail_eq
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem initial_image_tail_eq (x w : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Shao.C2.IntervalImageSpatialConvergence.spatialTailBlock 0 x w 1 0 n =
      Real.exp (-(8 * ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 2) * x * w)) +
        Real.exp (-(8 * ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 - 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 2) * x * w)) -
        Real.exp (-(2 * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 3) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + 2 * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 3) * x * w)) -
        Real.exp (-(2 * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 3) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 - 2 * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 3) * x * w))

declarations.name: antitoneOn_variation_le
monotoneOn_variation_le
variation_add_le
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem variation_add_le (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) :
    eVariationOn (fun w => f w + g w) S ≤ eVariationOn f S + eVariationOn g S

declarations.name: variation_neg_eq
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem variation_neg_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) :
    eVariationOn (fun w => -f w) S = eVariationOn f S

declarations.name: variation_le_of_pointwise_limit
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem variation_le_of_pointwise_limit (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (S : Set ℝ) (C : ENNReal)
    (hconv : ∀ w ∈ S, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => F N w) atTop (nhds (f w)))
    (hbound : ∀ N : ℕ, eVariationOn (F N) S ≤ C) :
    eVariationOn f S ≤ C

declarations.name: initial_image_geometric_majorants
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem initial_image_geometric_majorants (x v k : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hv : |v| ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-(8 * k ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + 4 * k * x * v)) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * k * x ^ 2) ∧
      Real.exp (-(8 * k ^ 2 * x ^ 2 - 4 * k * x * v)) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * k * x ^ 2) ∧
      Real.exp (-(2 * (2 * k + 1) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + 2 * (2 * k + 1) * x * v)) ≤
        Real.exp (-4 * k * x ^ 2) ∧
      Real.exp (-(2 * (2 * k + 1) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 - 2 * (2 * k + 1) * x * v)) ≤
        Real.exp (-4 * k * x ^ 2)

declarations.name: initial_geometric_ratio_bound
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem initial_geometric_ratio_bound (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    0 < Real.exp (-4 * x ^ 2) ∧ Real.exp (-4 * x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2

declarations.name: initial_geometric_series_budget
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem initial_geometric_series_budget (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr : r ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 2 * r ^ (n + 2) + 2 * r ^ (n + 1)) ∧
      (∑' n : ℕ, (2 * r ^ (n + 2) + 2 * r ^ (n + 1))) ≤ 6 * r ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 2 * r + (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (2 * r ^ (n + 2) + 2 * r ^ (n + 1))) ≤ 8 * r

declarations.name: actual_initial_double_completion_kernel
declarations.headOrValue:
theorem actual_initial_double_completion_kernel
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    let f : ℝ → ℝ := doubleCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) x
    let r : ℝ := Real.exp (-4 * x ^ 2)
    Continuous f ∧
      (∀ w : ℝ, 0 ≤ f w ∧ f w ≤ 8 * r) ∧
      eVariationOn f Set.univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (10 * r) ∧
      Tendsto f atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Tendsto f atBot (nhds 0)

antitone_bounded_expectation_error
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem antitone_bounded_expectation_error
    (mu rho : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
    (delta M : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hCDF : ∀ w : ℝ, |mu.real (Iic w) - rho.real (Iic w)| ≤ delta)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f)
    (hf0 : ∀ w, 0 ≤ f w) (hfM : ∀ w, f w ≤ M) :
    Integrable f mu ∧ Integrable f rho ∧
      |(∫ w : ℝ, f w ∂mu) - ∫ w : ℝ, f w ∂rho| ≤ M * delta

declarations.name: vanishing_bv_antitone_decomposition
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem vanishing_bv_antitone_decomposition
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hvar : eVariationOn f univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal V)
    (hleft : Tendsto f atBot (𝓝 0)) (hright : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ u v : ℝ → ℝ, Antitone u ∧ Antitone v ∧
      (∀ w, 0 ≤ u w ∧ u w ≤ V / 2) ∧
      (∀ w, 0 ≤ v w ∧ v w ≤ V / 2) ∧ (∀ w, f w = u w - v w)

declarations.name: vanishing_bv_expectation_error
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem vanishing_bv_expectation_error
    (mu rho : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
    (delta V : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hCDF : ∀ w : ℝ, |mu.real (Iic w) - rho.real (Iic w)| ≤ delta)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hvar : eVariationOn f univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal V)
    (hleft : Tendsto f atBot (𝓝 0)) (hright : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Integrable f mu ∧ Integrable f rho ∧
      |(∫ w : ℝ, f w ∂mu) - ∫ w : ℝ, f w ∂rho| ≤ V * delta

declarations.name: nonnegative_closed_cutoff_variation_le
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem nonnegative_closed_cutoff_variation_le
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hf0 : ∀ w, 0 ≤ f w) (hfM : ∀ w, f w ≤ M) (v : ℝ) :
    eVariationOn (fun w => if w ≤ v then f w else 0) univ ≤
      eVariationOn f univ + ENNReal.ofReal M

declarations.name: truncation_square_support_bound
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem truncation_square_support_bound
    (h y : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    y ^ 2 ≤ h ^ 2 * (if y = 0 then 0 else 1) + Shao.truncationF y / h

declarations.name: normalized_nonzero_support_lower_bound
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem normalized_nonzero_support_lower_bound
    (rho : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h2 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) rho)
    (hsecond : (∫ z : ℝ, z ^ 2 ∂rho) = 1)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    let normalizedLaw : Measure ℝ :=
      Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => z / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) rho
    let b : ℝ := Shao.truncationBudget normalizedLaw n x
    b ≤ 1 / 2 →
      0 < b ∧ (1 + x) ^ 6 / (8 * b ^ 2) ≤
        (n : ℝ) * rho.real {z : ℝ | z ≠ 0}

declarations.name: actual_iid_zero_energy_exponential
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem actual_iid_zero_energy_exponential
    (rho : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h2 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) rho)
    (hsecond : (∫ z : ℝ, z ^ 2 ∂rho) = 1)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    let normalizedLaw : Measure ℝ :=
      Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => z / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) rho
    let b : ℝ := Shao.truncationBudget normalizedLaw n x
    b ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => rho)).real {a : Shao.Path n | Shao.energy a = 0} ≤
        Real.exp (-((1 + x) ^ 6 / (8 * b ^ 2)))

declarations.name: rare_zero_gaussian_numeric
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem rare_zero_gaussian_numeric
    (x b : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hb : 0 < b) (hbsmall : b ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.exp (-((1 + x) ^ 6 / (8 * b ^ 2))) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * b * Shao.standardNormalTail x

declarations.name: double_kernel_gaussian_numeric
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem double_kernel_gaussian_numeric
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-4 * x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Shao.standardNormalTail x

declarations.name: actual_brownian_initial_double_integrals
declarations.headOrValue:
private theorem actual_brownian_initial_double_integrals
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (PB : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure PB]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B PB) (x : ℝ) :
    PB.real (brownianInitialDouble B x) =
      (∫ w : ℝ, doubleCompletion (bridgeLaw B PB) x w ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) ∧
    ∀ v : ℝ,
      PB.real (brownianInitialDouble B x ∩ {omega : Ω | B 1 omega ≤ v}) =
        (∫ w : ℝ, (if w ≤ v then doubleCompletion (bridgeLaw B PB) x w else 0)
          ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))

declarations.name: original_finite_second_initial_double_completion_budget
declarations.headOrValue:
theorem original_finite_second_initial_double_completion_budget :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (rho : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
        (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
        Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) rho →
        (∫ z : ℝ, z ∂rho) = 0 →
        (∫ z : ℝ, z ^ 2 ∂rho) = 1 →
        ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω]
          (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (PB : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure PB],
          IsBrownianReal B PB →
          ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x →
            let normalizedLaw : Measure ℝ :=
              Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => z / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) rho
            let b : ℝ := Shao.truncationBudget normalizedLaw n x
            let P : Measure (Shao.Path n) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => rho)
            let W : Shao.Path n → ℝ := Shao.C1.normalizedEndpoint
            let Z : Shao.Path n → ℝ := initialDoubleObservable (bridgeLaw B PB) x
            b ≤ 1 / 2 →
              Integrable Z P ∧
              |(∫ a : Shao.Path n, Z a ∂P) - PB.real (brownianInitialDouble B x)| ≤
                C * b * Shao.standardNormalTail x ∧
              ∀ v : ℝ,
                Integrable (fun a : Shao.Path n => if W a ≤ v then Z a else 0) P ∧
                |(∫ a : Shao.Path n, (if W a ≤ v then Z a else 0) ∂P) -
                  PB.real (brownianInitialDouble B x ∩ {omega : Ω | B 1 omega ≤ v})| ≤
                    C * b * Shao.standardNormalTail x

declarations.name: labelPermMeasurableSpace
declarations.headOrValue: local instance labelPermMeasurableSpace (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (LabelPerm n) := ⊤

declarations.name: actualDoubleValue
declarations.headOrValue:
def actualDoubleValue {n : ℕ} (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) (x : ℝ)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (r : ℕ) (sigma : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  1 - sourceValue .upper (eventCompletionKernel .upper Q) a x r sigma -
    sourceValue .lower (eventCompletionKernel .lower Q) a x r sigma +
    sourceValue .interval (eventCompletionKernel .interval Q) a x r sigma

declarations.name: actualDerivativeFamily
declarations.headOrValue:
def actualDerivativeFamily (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) : MonitoredDomain → BridgeKernel :=
  fun J => match J with
    | .upper => halflineDerivative .upper
    | .lower => halflineDerivative .lower
    | .interval => intervalDerivative Q

declarations.name: actualDoubleRetained
declarations.headOrValue:
def actualDoubleRetained {n : ℕ} (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) (x : ℝ)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (nu : LabelPerm n → ℕ) (r : ℕ) (sigma : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  sourceRetainedRemainder .interval (eventCompletionKernel .interval Q)
      (actualDerivativeFamily Q .interval) a x nu r sigma -
    sourceRetainedRemainder .upper (eventCompletionKernel .upper Q)
      (actualDerivativeFamily Q .upper) a x nu r sigma -
    sourceRetainedRemainder .lower (eventCompletionKernel .lower Q)
      (actualDerivativeFamily Q .lower) a x nu r sigma

declarations.name: actualDoubleSeparated
declarations.headOrValue:
def actualDoubleSeparated {n : ℕ} (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) (x : ℝ)
    (a : Shao.Path n) (nu : LabelPerm n → ℕ) (r : ℕ) (sigma : LabelPerm n) : ℝ :=
  sourceSeparatedOvershoot .upper (actualDerivativeFamily Q .upper) a x nu r sigma +
    sourceSeparatedOvershoot .lower (actualDerivativeFamily Q .lower) a x nu r sigma -
    sourceSeparatedOvershoot .interval (actualDerivativeFamily Q .interval) a x nu r sigma

declarations.name: doubleCrossingEvent
actual_double_value_boundary
declarations.headOrValue:
theorem actual_double_value_boundary
    {n : ℕ} (Q : Measure BridgeNoise) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : Shao.Path n) (sigma : LabelPerm n) :
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ n →
      0 ≤ actualDoubleValue Q x a r sigma ∧ actualDoubleValue Q x a r sigma ≤ 1) ∧
    actualDoubleValue Q x a 0 sigma =
      Shao.C2.InitialDoubleCompletionBudget.initialDoubleObservable Q x a ∧
    actualDoubleValue Q x a n sigma =
      if Shao.Probability.Spitzer.reorder a sigma ∈ doubleCrossingEvent x then 1 else 0

declarations.name: actual_double_stopped_telescope
declarations.headOrValue:
theorem actual_double_stopped_telescope
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (PB : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure PB]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B PB)
    (n : ℕ) (P : Measure (Shao.Path n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (H : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (nu : Shao.Path n → LabelPerm n → ℕ)
    (hnum : ∀ sigma, Measurable (fun a => nu a sigma))
    (hnu : ∀ a, IsRevealStoppingRank (nu a))
    (hcap : ∀ a sigma, nu a sigma ≤ energyCutoff a H sigma)
    (m : Shao.Path n → ℝ) (hmm : Measurable m) (hmb : ∀ a, |m a| ≤ 1)
    (hminv : PermutationInvariant m) :
    let Q : Measure BridgeNoise := bridgeLaw B PB
    let Z : (Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n) → ℝ := fun p =>
      m p.1 * (actualDoubleValue Q x p.1 (nu p.1 p.2) p.2 -
        Shao.C2.InitialDoubleCompletionBudget.initialDoubleObservable Q x p.1)
    let L : (Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n) → ℝ := fun p =>
      m p.1 * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, actualDoubleRetained Q x p.1 (nu p.1) r p.2
    let O : (Shao.Path n × LabelPerm n) → ℝ := fun p =>
      m p.1 * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, actualDoubleSeparated Q x p.1 (nu p.1) r p.2
    (∀ a sigma r, 0 ≤ actualDoubleSeparated Q x a (nu a) r sigma) ∧
    Integrable Z (revealLaw P) ∧ Integrable L (revealLaw P) ∧ Integrable O (revealLaw P) ∧
    (∫ p, Z p ∂revealLaw P) = (∫ p, L p ∂revealLaw P) - (∫ p, O p ∂revealLaw P) ∧
    ((∀ a, 0 ≤ m a) → (∫ p, Z p ∂revealLaw P) ≤ (∫ p, L p ∂revealLaw P))
